body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Jiwumedia (representative Yong-Soo, Park www.jiwumedia.com) presented ‘Miracle’, a wireless docking station utilizing UWB technology, at CES 2011, the biggest consumer electronics show in the world, on January.
(Picture: wireless docking station, presented by Jiwumedia at CES2011)

Jiwumedia, making a business in existing digital satellite broadcasting receiver, started to develop wireless communications related products from 2009, invented UWB product at the end of last year and introduced it to CES2011.
Miracle used UWB technology and can send laptop screen to TV or beam projector wirelessly. In other words, laptop screen can be seen via big screen in meeting room without connecting numerous lines.

According to the company official, after CES2011 there’re many inquiries about the product from a number of manufacturers including global home electronics companies and an educational institute actually used the wireless docking station at the beginning of this year.

Jiwumedia has also been accelerating in business of existing digital satellite broadcasting receiver products; their JTA-1100 was chosen as priority product regarding product registration by Korea Radio Promotion Association – a part of revitalizing distribution of digital broadcasting receiver following termination of analog TV broadcasting in 2012.
